info.title: aptu.dev
info.description: Machine-payable API infrastructure for autonomous agents.
info.x-guidance: All paid endpoints speak x402 v2: an unpaid request receives 402 with a PAYMENT-REQUIRED header; sign the exact-scheme authorization (USDC on Base via EIP-3009 or on Solana via the SVM exact scheme, payTo from the challenge) and retry with a PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header; a settled response carries PAYMENT-RESPONSE with the settlement receipt. Free surfaces are /.well-known/x402, /v1/catalog, /v1/openapi.json, /v1/self-check, and GET /v1/x401-probe (401 + PROOF-REQUEST, no payment). Unauthenticated probes always reach the 402 challenge before request-body validation.
